item.title: Selenium Interview Questions
item.description:
Beginner (Locators & Basics)

  1. What is Selenium?
  2. What is the role of Selenium/WebDriver in automation testing?
  3. What are the components of Selenium?
  4. What are the different types of locators in Selenium?
  5. Which locator do you use most in your project?
  6. What is the difference between / and // in XPath?
  7. Explain relative and absolute XPath?
  8. What are the different types of XPath?
  9. How do you launch a browser in Selenium?
  10. What is the difference between driver.get() and driver.navigate().to()?
  11. What is the difference between close() and quit()?
  12. What is the return type of getWindowHandles()?
  13. How do you handle dropdowns in Selenium?
  14. How do you handle alerts and pop-ups in Selenium?
  15. How do you take a screenshot in Selenium?

Intermediate (Wait, Frames & Actions)

  1. Explain the difference between implicit wait and explicit wait?
  2. What is fluent wait and when do you use it?
  3. How do you handle frames in Selenium?
  4. How do you handle windows/multiple tabs in Selenium?
  5. What is the Actions class and what are its methods?
  6. How do you simulate mouse hover actions in Selenium?
  7. How do you perform drag and drop in Selenium?
  8. What is the Select class and how do you use it?
  9. How do you handle dynamic elements in Selenium?
  10. What are common exceptions you have faced in Selenium?
  11. What is StaleElementReferenceException and how do you handle it?
  12. How do you handle a file upload in Selenium?
  13. How do you execute JavaScript in Selenium?
  14. How do you identify the color of a web element?
  15. How do you check if an element is enabled or displayed?

Advanced (Frameworks & Optimization)

  1. What is the Page Object Model (POM)?
  2. What is the difference between POM and Page Factory?
  3. How do you achieve parallel execution in Selenium?
  4. Explain Selenium Grid and its usage?
  5. What are assertions and how do you use them in your framework?
  6. Explain your framework architecture in detail?
  7. How do you manage test data in your Selenium project?
  8. How do you handle synchronization issues in Selenium?
  9. What is a WebDriverEventListener?
  10. What is headless testing and how do you perform it?
  11. How do you validate broken links on a webpage?
  12. Scenario: XPath is changing dynamically, how do you handle it?
  13. Scenario: An element is loaded but not interactable?

Questions with Answers

Beginner (Locators & Basics) - Answers

1. What is Selenium?

Answer: Selenium is an open-source suite of tools used for automating web browsers. It supports multiple programming languages (Java, Python, C#, etc.) and browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari).
